text: I failed one exam. My future is ruined. I'll never get a job. My life is over.
If this relationship ends, I will be alone forever and no one will ever love me again.
My boss didn't reply to my email immediately. They are definitely going to fire me tomorrow.
I don't want to think about it. Let's talk about something else. Whatever, it doesn't matter.
I'm skipping the interview. I'm just going to sleep all day and ignore their calls.
I am ignoring my emails and phone messages because facing them makes me too anxious.
I keep replaying that conversation in my head. I can't stop thinking about what they said. Every day I think about it again.
Why did I say that? I've been overthinking that meeting for hours, analyzing every single word I said.
I am stuck in a loop of thinking about my past mistakes and I cannot move on from it.
I must get a perfect score on my exams, otherwise I am not smart enough and am a complete failure.
If my work is not absolutely flawless, it is completely garbage. I cannot accept anything less than 100%.
I am terrified of making even a single mistake because it means I am incompetent.
I am such a disappointment. I hate myself for being so weak and constantly failing everyone.
I am completely useless and incompetent. I can't do anything right.
I blame myself entirely for this mess. I am just a stupid and lazy person.
